theorem Roth.eval_hasseDeriv_sub_eq_zero.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing S]
  {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α : S},
  (Polynomial.aeval α) f = 0 →
    ∀ {W' W'' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {j : σ →₀ ℕ},
      Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W') %ₘ f = Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W'') %ₘ f →
        (eval fun x ↦ α) ((hasseDeriv j) ((map (Int.castRingHom S)) (W' - W''))) = 0 :=
fun {σ} {S} [CommRing S] {f} {α} hfα {W' W''} {j} h ↦
  have hdvd :=
    Polynomial.dvd_modByMonic_iff_dvd.mp
      (of_eq_true
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (Dvd.dvd f)
            (Eq.trans
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Polynomial.modByMonic
                    (Eq.trans (congrArg Roth.diag (map_sub (hasseDeriv j) W' W''))
                      (Roth.diag_sub ((hasseDeriv j) W') ((hasseDeriv j) W''))))
                  f)
                (Polynomial.sub_modByMonic (Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W')) (Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W'')) f))
              (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HSub.hSub h) (Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W'') %ₘ f))
                (sub_self (Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W'') %ₘ f)))))
          (dvd_zero._simp_1 f)));
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (⇑(eval fun x ↦ α))
                (Eq.trans
                  (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑(hasseDeriv j)) (map_sub (map (algebraMap ℤ S)) W' W''))
                    (map_sub (hasseDeriv j) ((map (algebraMap ℤ S)) W') ((map (algebraMap ℤ S)) W'')))
                  (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (hasseDeriv_map (algebraMap ℤ S) j W'))
                    (hasseDeriv_map (algebraMap ℤ S) j W''))))
              (map_sub (eval fun x ↦ α) ((map (algebraMap ℤ S)) ((hasseDeriv j) W'))
                ((map (algebraMap ℤ S)) ((hasseDeriv j) W''))))
            (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (eval_map (algebraMap ℤ S) (fun x ↦ α) ((hasseDeriv j) W')))
              (eval_map (algebraMap ℤ S) (fun x ↦ α) ((hasseDeriv j) W'')))))
        0))
    (Eq.mp
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (⇑(Polynomial.aeval α))
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (⇑(aeval fun x ↦ Polynomial.X)) (map_sub (hasseDeriv j) W' W''))
                  (map_sub (aeval fun x ↦ Polynomial.X) ((hasseDeriv j) W') ((hasseDeriv j) W''))))
              (Polynomial.aeval_sub α))
            (congr
              (congrArg HSub.hSub
                (Eq.trans (comp_aeval_apply (fun x ↦ Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.aeval α) ((hasseDeriv j) W'))
                  (congrFun' (congrArg DFunLike.coe (congrArg aeval (funext fun i ↦ Polynomial.aeval_X α)))
                    ((hasseDeriv j) W'))))
              (Eq.trans (comp_aeval_apply (fun x ↦ Polynomial.X) (Polynomial.aeval α) ((hasseDeriv j) W''))
                (congrFun' (congrArg DFunLike.coe (congrArg aeval (funext fun i ↦ Polynomial.aeval_X α)))
                  ((hasseDeriv j) W''))))))
        0)
      (Polynomial.aeval_eq_zero_of_dvd_aeval_eq_zero hdvd hfα))

VANISH251_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing S] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α : S},
  (Polynomial.aeval α) f = 0 →
    ∀ {W' W'' : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {j : σ →₀ ℕ},
      Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W') %ₘ f = Roth.diag ((hasseDeriv j) W'') %ₘ f →
        (eval fun (x : σ) ↦ α) ((hasseDeriv j) ((map (Int.castRingHom S)) (W' - W''))) = 0
